notes.facilityLimits: Facility-count defaults now follow the current Aniimax release table. Aniimax marks counts as confirmed in game through RV 11; above RV 11, Farmland, Woodland and Mine continue their listed progression while other facility counts keep their RV 11 cap until further verification.
notes.unverifiedQuick: Quick Wool and Quick Scales yields are repository values; screenshots confirm base recipes and module unlocks, not these quick yields.
notes.energy: Food energy values are included only where supplied screenshots verify them. Worker draw defaults to 10 energy per minute and is editable.
notes.patchRV: RV costs and worker capacity verified against client 3846247 through level 22. Facility/module capacities and production rates remain guide estimates.
notes.patchPlanner: Facility placement limits and upgrade RV levels, RV costs, worker capacity and module RV requirements use client 3846247. Recipe rates remain guide estimates; unlock conditions beyond RV must be checked in-game.
